components.name: AnnouncementBar
components.description: A concise, non-dismissible editorial notice above site navigation, with an optional destination link.
components.html: THE FIRST COLLECTION IS TAKING SHAPE.
components.css: .ds-announcement { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 20px; background: var(--announcement); color: var(--announcement-foreground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--announcement-border); text-align: center; } .ds-announcement p { margin: 0; font: 600 12px/16px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Button / Primary
components.description: The decisive action in a local decision group, using Deep Ink on Ivory and measured Antique Gold on Midnight.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">SHOP FRAGRANCE</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--action-primary); color: var(--action-primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/20px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--action-primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button / Secondary
components.description: A bordered alternative that supports the primary action without competing with it.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary">SHOP FRAGRANCE</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--action-secondary-border); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--action-secondary-foreground); font: 600 14px/20px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--action-secondary-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--action-secondary-active); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button / Quiet
components.description: A borderless, low-emphasis utility action that recedes behind Primary and Secondary controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-quiet">SHOP FRAGRANCE</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--action-quiet-foreground); font: 600 14px/20px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--action-quiet-hover); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: var(--action-quiet-active); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button / Destructive
components.description: A restricted confirmation action for explicit consequential operations such as removing an item.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-destructive">REMOVE ITEM</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--action-destructive); color: var(--action-destructive-foreground); font: 600 14px/20px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: var(--action-destructive-hover); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { background: var(--action-destructive-active); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: TextLink / Inline
components.description: An always-underlined destination within prose, with an accessible deep-gold hover state on Ivory.
components.html: View delivery details
components.css: .ds-link-inline { border-radius: 2px; color: var(--link-inline); font: 500 16px/26px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-link-inline:hover { color: var(--link-hover); } .ds-link-inline:active { color: var(--link-active); } .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: TextLink / Standalone
components.description: A directional destination outside prose with a minimum 44px target, optional monochrome trailing icon, and accessible deep-gold hover on Ivory.
components.html: Explore the collection
components.css: .ds-link-standalone { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--link-standalone); font: 500 16px/26px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-link-standalone svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-link-standalone:hover { color: var(--link-hover); } .ds-link-standalone:active { color: var(--link-active); } .ds-link-standalone:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: TextLink / Inverse
components.description: The Midnight-surface link treatment, retaining a warm gold underline and visible focus.
components.html: Explore the collection

components.name: Input
components.description: A native single-line text or email control with approved Ivory and Midnight interaction states.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com">

components.name: Textarea

components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" placeholder="Tell us how we can help."></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { min-height: 112px; width: 100%; resize: vertical; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--field-surface); color: var(--field-text); font: 400 16px/24px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-textarea:hover { border-color: var(--field-border-hover); } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-textarea[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--field-error-border); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Visible label, optional or required status, native control, and one automatically associated supporting or error message.

components.name: ProductCard
components.description: A browse-only, whole-card product-detail link with inset 3:4 media, concise scent information, composed PriceDisplay, material commerce status, and a full-card focus ring.

REED DIFFUSER · 200ML

Cardamom · rose · sandalwood

narrative.overview: Infusion Diffusion uses deep contrast, measured gold, tactile materials, and generous quiet to make home fragrance feel composed and intimate. Product meaning remains clear before language becomes poetic.
keyCharacteristics: Black glass, warm metal, wax, vapor, flame, and shadow.
Precise product language and restrained ornament.
Luxury for lived-in rooms rather than decorative display alone.

rules.name: The Measured Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is a material edge and action cue, not a universal outline or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Use the approved Figma foreground/background pairs. Body text must meet WCAG AA, and focus must remain visibly distinct.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Marcellus expresses; Manrope explains and operates. Do not introduce a third decorative type voice.

rules.name: The One Depth Signal Rule
rules.body: Use a border or a shadow on a surface, not both.

dos: Do let typography, product imagery, proportion, and material contrast carry the identity.
Do keep scent format, notes, size, care, safety, price, stock, and delivery information concrete.
Do preserve true product proportions and controlled gold highlights in photography.
Do show diffusers, sprays, and candles as one coherent family.
donts: Don't use towels, stacked stones, scattered florals, or other familiar spa shorthand as the default photographic world.
Don't introduce generic AI-design tells: purple gradients, glowing surfaces, gratuitous pills, nested card grids, or vague decorative copy.
Don't crop caps, flames, spray triggers, or reed tips when the image's job is product recognition.
Don't change Figma, DESIGN.md, runtime tokens, or Storybook in isolation.
